name: inferred-traits
why: Nothing here is stated except one fact (Sam is a carpenter). Everything else — apologising, 'talk later', brevity — invites the inferred-trait failure ('Sam is shy', 'Sam tends to apologise', 'prefers to end with talk later'). Both prompts forbid inference; a wrong auto-fact persists into every later prompt.

messages: um. hi. sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt your reading.
*Mira closes the book.* "You're not interrupting. Sit."
sorry. thanks. long day at the workshop. I build furniture, mostly chairs. I'm a carpenter.
"A carpenter! That explains the sawdust in your hair."
ok. anyway. I should go. talk later?
